pairs.source_text: Exponential Backoff with Jitter: To prevent thundering herds when services recover, clients should multiply retry delays exponentially and add uniform random jitter.
pairs.target_text: Retry strategy for webhook delivery: Webhook dispatchers must use exponential backoff with randomized jitter on 5xx responses to avoid overwhelming recovering servers.

pairs.source_text: We decided to make all database writes synchronous.
pairs.target_text: We decided to make all database writes asynchronous.

pairs.source_text: Primary storage engine must be SQLite in WAL mode.
pairs.target_text: Primary storage engine must be PostgreSQL server.

pairs.source_text: All API endpoints require JWT authentication.
pairs.target_text: API endpoints must remain unauthenticated for public access.

pairs.source_text: Cache eviction policy is strictly LRU.
pairs.target_text: Cache eviction policy is strictly FIFO.

pairs.source_text: Maximum payload size is capped at 10MB.
pairs.target_text: Maximum payload size is capped at 100MB.

pairs.source_text: Client connections must use HTTP/2 only.
pairs.target_text: Client connections must use HTTP/1.1 only.

pairs.source_text: Worker threads run at high real-time priority.
pairs.target_text: Worker threads run at idle background priority.

pairs.source_text: Configuration is loaded exclusively from environment variables.
pairs.target_text: Configuration is loaded exclusively from YAML config files.

pairs.source_text: We chose raft consensus for cluster coordination.
pairs.target_text: We rejected raft consensus and chose paxos.

pairs.source_text: All timestamps are stored in millisecond UTC.
pairs.target_text: All timestamps are stored in local system timezone.

pairs.source_text: On Linux, file events use inotify.
pairs.target_text: On macOS, file events use FSEvents.

pairs.source_text: In v1.0, data was stored in plain text.
pairs.target_text: In v2.0, data is encrypted with AES-GCM.

pairs.source_text: For mobile clients, bandwidth is limited to 1Mbps.
pairs.target_text: For desktop clients, bandwidth is unlimited.

pairs.source_text: In testing environment, SQLite in-memory is used.
pairs.target_text: In production environment, SQLite file-backed WAL is used.

pairs.source_text: For free tier users, rate limit is 10 req/min.
pairs.target_text: For enterprise tier users, rate limit is 1000 req/min.

pairs.source_text: Internal microservices use gRPC.
pairs.target_text: External public APIs use REST JSON.

pairs.source_text: Development builds have debug logging enabled.
pairs.target_text: Production builds have debug logging disabled.

pairs.source_text: In memory-constrained devices, cache size is 16MB.
pairs.target_text: In server deployments, cache size is 4GB.

pairs.source_text: Legacy export format uses XML.
pairs.target_text: Current export format uses JSON.

pairs.source_text: Windows builds use named pipes for IPC.
pairs.target_text: Unix builds use domain sockets for IPC.
